anchor_query:
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?var1 ("P3866" AS ?var2) (concat(", ?var3 , ") AS ?var4)
WHERE
  { BIND(strafter(?var5, "DE/") AS ?var3)
    BIND(replace(str(?var6), ".*Q", "Q") AS ?var1)
    ?var6  wdt:P1183  ?var5
    FILTER strstarts(?var5, "DE/")
    FILTER regex(?var5, "^DE/.{8,}$")
    MINUS
      { ?var6  wdt:P3866  ?var7 }
  }
ORDER BY ASC(?var5)

PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT DISTINCT  *
WHERE
  { ?var1  wdt:P281  ?var2
    FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?var1  wdt:P17  _:b0 }
    FILTER ( ! regex(?var2, "^[0-9]{5}$") )
    FILTER ( ! regex(?var2, "string1") )
    FILTER ( ! regex(?var2, "string2") )
    FILTER regex(?var2, "[^0-9]")
  }
ORDER BY ASC(?var2)
